GeoNames sample rows used by the tests.

cities_sample.txt         seven rows copied unchanged from GeoNames cities15000.txt (Lahore, Faisalabad, Dubai, Sydney, London GB and CA, New York City)
cities_global_sample.txt  ten rows copied unchanged from cities15000.txt, one per required test location plus a no-state country and two cities with the same name in different states (Richmond CA and VA)
admin1_sample.txt         eight rows copied unchanged from admin1CodesASCII.txt
admin1_global_sample.txt  eight rows copied unchanged from admin1CodesASCII.txt, for the states of cities_global_sample.txt

Source: https://www.geonames.org/  (download: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/)

The rows were not edited. Keep this note with the files if they are moved or copied.
